name: Black SADA Cotton Bra – Soft  3 Hook Support Bra for Women
description:
Experience all-day comfort and reliable support with the Black SADA Cotton Bra, designed for everyday wear. Made from soft, breathable cotton, this non-wired bra offers a natural shape and a smooth fit under any outfit. The 3-hook back closure ensures a secure  and good fit, while the wide shoulder straps reduce pressure and prevent slipping.
Whether you're at home, at work, or on the go, this bra provides the support you need without compromising on comfort. Its minimalist design and classic black color make it a must-have essential in every woman’s lingerie collection.




 Key Features:

 	
Material: Soft, breathable cotton for all-day comfort

 	
Fit: 3-hook back closure for added support and adjustability

 	
Straps: Adjustable wide straps to reduce shoulder pressure

 	
Style: Seamless look under clothes – ideal for daily wear

 	
Color: Classic black
